claims.verbatim:
The steamship Saint David, from Liverpool 25th, via
Londonderry 29th of June, passed Father Point at half-
past ten o'clock[?] last night on her voyage to Quebec.
Her telegraphic news report is one day later than the
advices of the City of London, published in the HERALD
yesterday morning.
